goals.description: Determine the requested rule name/export name, choose the appropriate rule archetype, read the relevant references, inspect shared AST utilities, and check nearby rules for reusable patterns or an existing rule to extend.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on context gathering and implementation choice. Normalize the requested rule name and export name, read the archetype guidance and any needed schema/style references, inspect shared AST utilities and similar rules, and decide whether this is a new rule or an extension of an existing/config-driven rule.
goals.name: Inspect rule context

goals.description: Extract or add reusable AST helper logic when an existing rule solves a similar problem or the new rule needs shared traversal/value handling.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Only edit shared utility code if the inspection found a concrete reusable pattern or duplication worth extracting. Keep this scoped to shared AST utilities and any required import adjustments for existing similar logic; otherwise treat this goal as a no-op.
goals.name: Prepare shared utilities

goals.description: Create or update the ESLint rule implementation with correct metadata, schema handling when needed, AST visitors from the chosen archetype, diagnostics, and safe autofix behavior when appropriate.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on the rule implementation file. Use the chosen archetype and shared utilities, follow naming conventions, add schema only if options are needed, and implement autofix by default unless the skill's unsafe-fix criteria apply.
goals.name: Implement rule source

goals.description: Create or update RuleTester coverage with valid and invalid cases, filenames, message IDs, changed-behavior coverage, and required output assertions for fixable rules.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on the rule spec file. Cover valid and invalid examples for the intended behavior, update existing tests if this extends a rule, and include output for every invalid case when the rule is fixable.
goals.name: Author rule tests

goals.description: Register the rule export in the plugin rules index and enable it in the scraps ESLint config with any required options.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on registration files. Add the rule to the rules index and to the `name: 'plugin/@sentry/scraps'` config block, preserving existing ordering/style and using options only if the implemented schema requires them.
goals.name: Register rule

goals.description: Run the targeted RuleTester command and perform final consistency checks across implementation, tests, registration, naming, autofix metadata, and expected outputs.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on validation. Run the targeted `CI=true pnpm test` command for the rule spec, then check that naming, exports, config registration, fixable metadata, and test outputs are all consistent with the implemented behavior.
goals.name: Validate rule
